scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a crowded stadium concert, [X] compares lower-garment categories by how their fabric construction handles concrete stairs, hard seats, sustained dancing, loaded secure pockets, indoor heat, and the colder walk back to the car.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在参加拥挤的体育场演唱会前，[X]会比较不同下装类别的织物结构能否应对水泥台阶、硬座、长时间跳舞、装有随身物的安全口袋、场内热气以及散场后更冷的步行路程。
examples: using Jersey Knit, Rib Knit, Interlock Knit, Ponte Knit, or Double Knit when repeated movement should not cause binding
comparing Denim with a more flexible knit when hard seating and three hours of dancing expose stiffness
considering Mesh, Terry, or Microfiber only when sweat handling does not undermine pocket stability or the colder exit

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While packing with family for a four-day route from Tokyo to mountain towns and a near-freezing evening festival, [X] builds a small lower-body rotation that can layer under wind protection, cope with possible wet ground, keep the children comfortable, and repack easily after long bus transfers.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与家人为一条为期四天、从东京前往山城并参加接近冰点夜间祭典的路线准备行李时，[X]会建立一套精简下装轮换：既要便于叠穿防风层、应对可能湿滑的地面、保证孩子舒适，也要在长途巴士换乘后容易重新收纳。
examples: using Fleece or a stable Interlock Knit as a thin thermal layer rather than relying on an unlayered light legging
using Softshell or Ripstop when wind and damp ground matter more than a dressier surface
using Denim or Twill only when its drying time, bulk, and next-stop repacking remain acceptable

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When preparing for international travel without a fixed climate, [X] limits the suitcase to two bottoms and assigns each a role across humid heat, snow, desert temperature swings, monsoon rain, and transitional weather, prioritizing layering, drying, abrasion, and pack volume over a separate pair for every forecast.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在尚未确定具体气候的国际旅行准备中，[X]会把行李限制为两件下装，并让它们分别承担湿热、冰雪、沙漠昼夜温差、季风降雨和过渡天气中的任务，以叠穿、干燥速度、耐磨和收纳体积取代“每种天气各带一条”的做法。
examples: using Mesh, Microfiber, or a light Jersey Knit where ventilation and quick drying dominate
using Ripstop, Softshell, or Canvas where wind, abrasion, and repeated outdoor use dominate
using Fleece, Interlock Knit, or Terry as a layer while avoiding heavy Denim when repeated washing and drying are unlikely

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While recovering from tailbone pain, [X] changes lower-garment categories during desk sessions on a wedge cushion and sit-to-stand transitions, treating surface texture, rear-seam bulk, stretch recovery, and pressure against the sore area as reasons to accept or reject a fabric construction.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在尾骨疼痛恢复期间，[X]会在楔形坐垫上的办公时段和坐站转换中更换不同下装类别，并把表面纹理、后部接缝厚度、弹性恢复以及对疼痛区域的压力作为接受或排除某种织物结构的依据。
examples: using Jersey Knit, Rib Knit, Interlock Knit, Terry, Ponte Knit, or Double Knit when low pressure and recovery matter
comparing Fleece, Velvet, Corduroy, or Microfiber by pile, friction, and seam bulk against the painful area
keeping Denim only when its structure and rear seams do not recreate the pressure the user is avoiding

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before cleaning a named suit at home, [X] checks the jacket and trousers together, follows the care labels, protects both pieces from agitation, and later compares whether the trouser surface, crease, drape, and finish still match the jacket before deciding whether the method is repeatable.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在家清洁明确提到的西装前，[X]会把上衣与西裤一并检查，遵循洗护标签并避免强烈搅动；干燥后再比较西裤的表面、裤线、垂感和光泽是否仍与上衣匹配，以决定这种方法能否重复使用。
examples: checking whether Satin, Velvet, Crepe, or Jacquard Knit changes sheen, pile, or drape under moisture
using Twill only when the tailored surface and crease recover beside the matching jacket
treating Microfiber, Ponte Knit, or Double Knit as washable only after shape and finish return

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When comparing everyday jeans for school, [X] examines fabric weight, weave density, stitching, hardware, wash behavior, comfort through a long class day, and likely years of use instead of assuming that a designer label or lower price determines construction quality.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为学校日常穿着比较牛仔裤时，[X]会检查织物克重、织造密度、车线、五金、洗后变化、长课日中的舒适度以及可能的使用年限，而不是默认设计师品牌或低价本身就能决定结构质量。
examples: comparing dense Denim with lighter Chambray when longevity and all-day comfort pull in different directions
checking Twill or Canvas by weave stability, stress seams, and wash change rather than surface appearance alone
considering Corduroy only after its ridges, abrasion points, and care burden fit the student's routine

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Drawing on a long-running costume-making hobby, [X] reviews two handmade character outfits that were packed, photographed, worn at public events, grabbed by a child, and exposed to campfire ash, comparing how the actual flared skirts, frills, lining, and reinforcement balanced softness, shape, wrinkles, tearing, and movement.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 凭借长期制作角色服装的爱好经验，[X]会复盘两套亲手制作、装箱运输、拍摄并在公开活动中穿过的服装；其中裙摆还曾被孩子拉扯并接触篝火灰烬，因此可以比较真实喇叭裙、荷叶边、里布与加固层如何平衡柔软度、造型、褶皱、撕裂和活动性。
examples: comparing Chiffon, Lace, Organza, or Tulle when a fluttering edge must remain visible without collapsing
using Satin, Velvet, or Crepe only when its drape and surface can survive packing and repeated handling
testing Jacquard Knit or a reinforced woven body when the skirt needs strength without repeating the failed stiffness

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a medieval-inspired half-elf cosplay, [X] organizes lower-body pieces from underlayers through skirts, stockings, leggings, insulation, and armor, choosing fabric constructions by layer order, skin contact, heat, chafing, mobility, decoration, and whether later pieces can be put on without disturbing earlier ones.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在规划中世纪风格的半精灵 cosplay 时，[X]会从贴身层到裙装、长袜、紧身裤、保暖层和护甲依次组织下半身部件，并依据层叠顺序、皮肤接触、热量、摩擦、活动性、装饰效果，以及后续部件是否会破坏先穿层来选择织物结构。
examples: using Lace, Mesh, or a light decorative knit only where skin contact and later layers do not snag it
using Jersey Knit, Interlock Knit, Ponte Knit, or Double Knit where a base leg layer must stretch and recover
using Canvas or Ripstop where belts, armor, and props need a stable abrasion-resistant support layer

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five women, [X] creates a dress theme using golf skirts, skorts, shorts, jeans, and coordinated sets to balance afternoon comfort, a recognizable group photograph, and playful details without turning the event into a restrictive costume requirement.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位女性参加的户外午宴进行组织时，[X]会设计着装主题，以高尔夫裙、裙裤、短裤、牛仔裤和成套穿搭平衡下午活动的舒适度、清晰可辨的集体合影和趣味细节，同时避免把活动变成严格的服装扮演要求。
examples: using Lace or Satin as a limited trim when an after-dark twist should not undermine outdoor comfort
using Jersey Knit for a flexible golf bottom or Denim for the rock-influenced version
using Poplin for a crisp short or skirt direction when the group theme needs structure without heavy weight

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When shopping for a hot-weather Italy trip, [X] rejects an initial fast-fashion list and compares summer shorts through breathability, structure, sweat, washability, durability, sustainability claims, shipping, and customs rather than treating every lightweight-looking construction as equally comfortable or responsible.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为炎热天气下的意大利旅行购物时，[X]会拒绝最初的快时尚清单，并从透气性、挺括度、出汗、洗护、耐用性、可持续性声明、配送和关税等方面比较夏季短裤，而不是把所有看起来轻薄的织物结构都视为同样舒适或符合责任消费原则。
examples: comparing Poplin, Chambray, or light Twill when the shorts should look polished but remain breathable
using Jersey Knit or Terry when softness and easy movement matter more than a tailored line
using light Canvas only when its durability does not recreate the heavy, sweaty feel the user is trying to avoid
